thread_analysis.thread_summary: This thread is a duplicate/overlapping capture of the same internal Allion RF PHY logo test coordination for an Alinco DUT at Allion's Taiwan HQ lab already fully documented in thread_0231 (Toshitaka Mochizuki, Leo Chou, Ning Lin, Itsuo Sakai) — covering the same DUT power-on/USB driver/cable troubleshooting and the same LE Power Class 1 misclassification issue (SoC qualified under Core Specification v5.2, which predates the Power Class 1 definition) resolved via a 'Non-power class 1' test configuration rather than a firmware update.
